shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Full cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), transit animations (§73), and a subsystem-health panel. Workshop 3776015553. Window 9 (Transit Animations) published, tree RESTORED to build mode, git pushed. Owed: Workshop smoke test (validates w9), notes-paste confirm, §62.N/§70 verifies, upstream paste.

**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks (SUPERSEDED by §62); §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §45-50 field-report fixes; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework (SHIPPED) + §62.N (SHIPPED w8, field-unverified); §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion (SHIPPED); §68 KCSG/VFEM2 (SHIPPED); §69 stair temperature (SHIPPED); §70 band flora legality (SHIPPED w8, field-unverified) + §70.B cavern regrowth (OPEN, priced); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; upstream report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos (SHIPPED w8, user-verified); §73 transit animations (USER-VERIFIED run #305, SHIPPED with window 9). Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED from the tree (its files survive in git history pre-a50a744). ~117 .cs files, ~34,000 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

The Workshop smoke test (ledger 1) verifies the upload either way; the paste is owed item 2 until the user confirms it.

Checkpoint habit + push-before-strip both held through window 9.

**⚠ OWED, IN ORDER:** (1) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST - NEXT SESSION'S FIRST TASK (validates the window 9 upload; subsumes the window 8 smoke debt, now four windows old):** subscribe to 3776015553, load from the WORKSHOP copy (not the workspace symlink), banded colony, one column of each type, one link-gizmo click, one stairs crossing (transit clip visible = §73 carried, Release dll carried). (2) User confirms the "Window 9: Transit Animations" change notes were pasted into the Steam WEB editor (`docs/UPDATE_NOTES.txt`; window 8's text is in git history if it was never pasted). (3) User pastes the Smooth Terrain upstream report (`docs/UPSTREAM_SmoothTerrain.md` → workshop 3502765685), ledger 5c. (4) §62.N/§70 field verifies when the right companion sets are in a session (ledger 1b/1c).

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (live on the Workshop):** §62.N (needs a VE-pipe session) and §70 (needs a Biomes! Caverns session), both since window 8. Riding from window 7: §62.M, §66c, §66e. USER-VERIFIED: §72, §72.b, §71 baseline (w8); §73 (run #305, zero bridge errors).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans are COMPAT ONLY. (2) Building-sprite art comes from the USER via Nano Banana Pro prompt kits (user lore, assets topic); agent-generated SVG building art was rejected as "cheap art". render_svg_to_png is for flat UI geometry only. (3) About.xml description is the USER's copy - never rewrite during publish prep, only on explicit request. (4) When the user asks for N mockups of a feature, they want N CHOICES to pick between, not N instances of one design - present OPTIONS.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE THIRTY-EIGHT RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION (§29e/§46/§53/§56.4). 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` (§29c). 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS (§56.3). 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD ON WHAT IS ON THE MAP. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): **`TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME.** 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY GATE THAT ASKS "IS THIS MAP READY YET". 21 (§58): **THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT.** 22 (§59): **A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT.** 23 (§60): **AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL.** 24 (§61a): **CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR.** 25 (§61b): **A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED.** 26 (§61f): **EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE SAME "IS IT DRAWN" GATE THE RENDERER USES.** 27 (§62c): **PREFER THE OPERATION EVERY HOST IS ALREADY FORCED TO HANDLE (SPAWN/DESPAWN) OVER THE ONE EACH HOST HANDLES ITS OWN WAY (FLICK).** 28 (§63a): **A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE.** 29 (§0b): **REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS.** 30 (§66d): **A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER.** 31 (§66f): **WHEN A GUARDED HANDOFF FAILS IN THE FIELD, MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED.** 32 (§69a): **TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT.** 33 (§62k): **A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO.** 34 (§62l): **AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER, NOT JUST THE MAP MESH; the map mesh and each overlay are SEPARATE METHODS.** 35 (§62n): **MAKING A CLONED FOREIGN DEF VISIBLE ENTERS IT INTO EVERY FOREIGN LOOKUP THE HOST BUILT FROM ITS OWN AUTHORED LISTS - AND IT IS IN NONE OF THEM.** 36 (§70a): **WHEN WE SPAWN SOMETHING VANILLA NORMALLY SPAWNS, WE MUST RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE, NOT A SUMMARY OF IT.** 37 (§71a): **NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. Read the engine's own handler for the transition you are predicting.** 38 (§73): **WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, THERE MAY BE NO DRAW CALL THERE TO PATCH - own the draw: all three DynamicDrawPhases at the target loc, veto the atlas blit, key every phase off ACTUAL state (stagger durations are stat-scaled and advisory).**
